propositions: Changing a ticket's type silently carries forward a plan-review verdict computed under different type-dependent criteria, replaying the old verdict without re-running the LLM.
Both reuse paths (idempotent_reuse and verdict_reuse) in reuse.py compare material_fingerprint and code SHA but never compare ticket_type, allowing wrong verdicts to persist across type changes.

Type gates scoring in four places (orchestrator and workflow_ops), so a plan that PASSes as bug (exempt) but retyped to task (not exempt) incorrectly keeps the PASS when the same plan would BLOCK under current type criteria.
The REVIEW_RESULT sidecar already records ticket_type, so validating type match requires no schema change, only reading the stored type in both reuse paths and returning None on mismatch.
Reuse must fail open when stored type is absent or empty, preserving existing certifications written before this fix and allowing them to naturally re-earn binding on next plan change.
